audience: sales, HR and legal teams who send documents for signature with Dropbox Sign

useCases.title: See which signature requests are still waiting
useCases.text: The AI lists your signature requests, newest first, and opens each one to show its status and which signers have not signed yet.

useCases.title: Get the signed files of a finished request
useCases.text: The AI opens a signature request and returns a temporary URL to download the signed documents.

useCases.title: Review your templates, their roles and fields
useCases.text: The AI lists your reusable templates and opens one to show its fields, roles and metadata, so you know which template fits a contract.

useCases.title: Remind a signer or cancel a pending request
useCases.text: The AI finds an incomplete signature request, then sends a reminder email to a signer or cancels the request so nobody can sign it.

useCases.title: Send a contract from a template to signers
useCases.text: The AI builds a signature request from a template and sends it to the signers you name. It runs in test mode by default and sends a real request only when you ask.
